description: Matrix Plume is a matrix that opens up in place. Put a hierarchy in rows (Region › City, Category › Product), your periods in columns (Year › Month) and one or more measures in values. Subtotals and totals are computed by Power BI itself, so they stay right for averages and ratios. Free features, no watermark Explore: open or close a group with + / −, a double-click or the arrow keys; Expand all / Collapse all; the state is saved with the report. Totals: subtotals on the group row or in a Total row below, column subtotals, a grand total that stays visible. Layout: stepped or tabular, multi-level column headers frozen while you scroll, clear lines between column groups. Find and sort: search a row (its parents stay visible); click a value header to sort every level. Format each measure: alignment, units, decimals, prefix and suffix, colored negatives, bold, colors and width; drag a column edge to resize it. Interact: click a row, a cell or a header to cross-filter the page; Ctrl + click; right-click menu. Dynamic formatting: drive any Format pane setting with a DAX measure. For everyone: keyboard navigation, screen readers, high contrast, English and French. Your colors: follows the report theme; custom colors; Minimal and Black & White styles.
